name: ergoptiplus-video
description: Remotion promo film and README feature GIFs for Ergopti+, rendered from the driver's own UI and data

scripts.studio: npm run prepare-data && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run prepare-data && remotion render src/index.ts Promo out/ergoptiplus-promo.draft.mp4 && node scripts/check-flicker.mjs out/ergoptiplus-promo.draft.mp4 && node -e "require('fs').renameSync('out/ergoptiplus-promo.draft.mp4', 'out/ergoptiplus-promo.mp4')"
